shortBio.en: King Crimson's constant—while almost everything else in the band is a lineup version.
shortBio.zh: King Crimson 的常量——而乐队里几乎其他一切都是阵容版本。

whyHub.en: The method person: Crimson is a way of working; Fripp is the through-line across radical reformations.
whyHub.zh: 方法型人物：Crimson 是一种做事方式；Fripp 是剧烈重组之间的贯穿线。

body.en: If Zeppelin teaches stable Classic IV, Fripp teaches the opposite: keep one hub person, replace the instrument cast. Lineup versions on the Crimson band page are chapters of one method.
body.zh: 若 Zeppelin 教稳定经典四人组，Fripp 教相反课：保住一个枢纽人物，更换乐器卡司。Crimson 乐队页上的阵容版本，是同一种方法的多章。
